title: Translation and Literary Design of Matthew 6:1-4
caption: <bp-cite>Matthew 6:1-4</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: The Messianic Torah (2024).
usx:
<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
        <verse number="1" /> Be careful about <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">your doing-what-is-right</char>; 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
        <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="red">don’t</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">do</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">it</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">in front of</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="purple">people</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="3" sidebar-value="c">
        <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">for the purpose</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">of being seen by them</char>. 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group indent="4" sidebar-value="d">
        If you do, 
      </group>
      <group indent="4">
        you will have no <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">reward</char>
      </group>
      <group indent="4">
        from <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">your Father in the skies</char>. 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="1" type="secondary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
        <verse number="2" /> So then, <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">when you</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">do</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">acts of generous giving</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b'">
        <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="red">don’t</char> signal with a trumpet before you, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2">
        <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">like the hypocrites</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">do</char>
      </group>
      <group indent="2">
        <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">in the gathering places and alleyways</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="3" sidebar-value="c'">
        <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">in order that</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">they can be honored by people</char>. 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group indent="4" sidebar-value="d'">
        Truly, I tell you: 
      </group>
      <group indent="4">
        they have fully received their <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">reward</char>. 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a''">
        <verse number="3" /> But <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">when you’re</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">doing</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">generous giving</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b''">
        <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="red">don’t</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">let your left hand know what your right hand</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">does</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="3" sidebar-value="c''">
        <verse number="4" /> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">so that</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">your generous giving can be</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="green">in hiddenness</char>, 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group indent="4" sidebar-value="d''">
        and <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">your Father</char> who sees what is <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="green">in hiddenness</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="4">
        he will fully <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">repay</char> you. 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
</usx>
